mu_name_from: MuMain loads boot indexes 10 to 14 from BootElf{i+1} (ZzzOpenData.cpp line 152: `AccessModel(MODEL_BOOTS + i + 10, ..., L"BootElf", i + 1)`), so index 12 is BootElf03, which openmu's 0.75 Armors.cs names the Wind Boots. Group 11 index 12, Player/BootElf03.bmd.
why_this_one: The Fairy Elf's third set, sold beside Silk: Elf Lala in Noria carries all five pieces at +3 (src/sim/market.cpp, kElfLala, the index-12 rows). Here so that her shelf shows the pieces it sells rather than their names.
profile_from: Not armour, whose default is plate_steel: nothing in this set is a forged plate. The sheets are blue quilted fabric with a darker blue scroll worked into it, no metal colour anywhere but the Armor's two tan straps. See profiles/soft_armour.json.

stats.note: The item's own row, copied from OpenMU's 0.75 initialiser rather than restated, with the call it came from beside it.
stats.from: openmu/src/Persistence/Initialization/Version075/Items/Armors.cs line 133. The 0.75 table, which is the version this server is being built to.
stats.call_note: ArmorInitializerBase.CreateBoots(number, slot, width, height, name, dropLevel, defense, walkSpeed, durability, strengthRequirement, agilityRequirement, darkWizardClassLevel, darkKnightClassLevel, elfClassLevel). Slot 6, so the group is 11.
stats.defense_note: Points of defence, in the row and summed into Player.ArmourDefense by Wear - see shared/Rows.cs.
stats.walk_speed_note: Nought, as on the Vine Boots: the elf's boots carry no walk bonus in 0.75's row.
stats.classes_from: The last three ints of the call are 0, 0, 1 - the Fairy Elf alone. 80 agility beside thirty strength is the row saying the same thing in stats.

sheet_from: Data/Player/boots_09c.OZJ (64x64) and hide.jpg, from MuMain. The .bmd names boots_09c.jpg and hide.jpg; 114 of the 120 triangles are on the first and 6 on hide.
sheet_note: boots_09c is a blue quilted boot with the darker scroll at the knee and a black block of unused sheet at the right edge. Mean (81, 96, 123) at chroma 43. hide caps the opening.
material_note: cloth on both islands, the two boots at 60 each (boots_09c's 114 and hide's 6). Blue quilted fabric with the scroll at the knee; the black block at the sheet's right edge is unused sheet.
